title: Break Sokos Hotel Ruka tops out, opens in November 2027
seoTitle: Break Sokos Hotel Ruka opens in November 2027
description: The frame of the new Break Sokos Hotel Ruka is finished and the 217-room hotel opens in November 2027. Rooms go on sale at sokoshotels.fi in March 2027.
dek: Rooms go on sale at sokoshotels.fi in March 2027, so a night at the hotel cannot be booked yet. The building has 217 rooms on seven floors in the middle of Ruka village.
heroAlt: Frost-covered spruces and birches along a river in Kuusamo in the morning sun. Mist rises from the open rapids, and the banks are under deep snow.
heroCaption: The Käylänkoski rapids in Kuusamo in February 2020. The new hotel is being built in the centre of Ruka village and is not in the photo.

body.text: Osuuskauppa Arina celebrated the topping out of Break Sokos Hotel Ruka on 26 November 2026. The frame of the hotel going up in the centre of Ruka village is finished, the roof is being completed and the work has moved indoors. The hotel opens in November 2027.

body.title: Break Sokos Hotel Ruka in brief
items: Booking calendar opens: March 2027 at sokoshotels.fi
People working on the site now: about 90
Staff once the hotel is open: about 40 year-round, about 80 in the season

body.title: This hotel cannot be booked yet
body.text: The booking calendar opens in March 2027 and the first guests arrive in November 2027. Compare the places in Ruka that take guests this winter.
What is being built in Ruka right now

Construction started in the autumn of 2025 and the cornerstone was laid in January 2026. About 90 people are working on the site at the moment. The roof is in its final stage, and inside the building the work moves floor by floor from partition walls to plastering and painting.

The plot is a rocky slope, and according to Arina it has called for special solutions both in the foundations and in the rock construction. A rainy summer and autumn added to the difficulty. The company says the project has avoided major surprises and is still running on its original schedule.
217 rooms, a Trattoria and an outdoor sauna

The hotel has 217 rooms and seven floors, with the parking hall on the bottom floor. It will also have an Italian restaurant called Trattoria, a Coffee House, meeting rooms, a playroom for children, a gym and a sauna world. The detail Arina highlights is a sauna that sits outdoors and looks out over the landscape; the first renderings of it were published at the topping-out event.

According to Arina, the breakfast and dining restaurant looks out over the Koillismaa fell landscape and Lake Talvijärvi. PAVE Arkkitehdit is responsible for the architecture and Vertti & Co for the interiors. The main contractor is Hartela and ARE is building the technical systems.
For anyone driving, the hotel has 104 parking spaces, 46 of them in the car park hall. There are 24 ABC charging points for electric cars, four of which are high-power.
When can you book a room?

The booking calendar opens at sokoshotels.fi in March 2027. Arina says sales open in March to co-op members, to other private customers and to companies. International sales started back in 2025, and the tour operators that have shown interest are in Spain, the United Kingdom, Germany, Belgium, Turkey and Ireland.

So if you are planning a trip to Ruka for the winter that starts in November 2027, you cannot book a room in this hotel before March. For the winters before that, book one of the places in Ruka that are open now.

Arina is recruiting a hotel manager at the moment. Recruitment of the department managers starts in March and April, and the rest of the team in July and August 2027. The company estimates that the hotel will employ about 40 people year-round, rising to about 80 in the busiest season. The construction phase alone is estimated at about 250 person-years of work.
A smaller hotel is being planned on the other side of the fell in Saarua, but that project is still at the planning stage.
